questions.q: What Stoic practice helps you handle things you cannot change?
questions.why: Stoicism teaches acceptance of uncontrollable factors.

questions.q: Which historical figure used a horse's weakness to overcome an obstacle?
What mental shift allows you to see solutions to others' problems?
questions.why: Viewing problems objectively reveals clear actions.

questions.q: According to Holiday, what fuels persistence after gaining perspective?
questions.why: Will enables continued effort toward a solution.

questions.q: What does the book suggest about the size of an obstacle?
a: Larger obstacles have exploitable weak spots
questions.why: Big obstacles often contain a vulnerable point to use.
